verdict.rationale: Zero is an open-source email app with an MCP capability list, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no public HTTP API, no version scheme and no deprecation policy. The only programmatic surface is a prose MCP capability list with no endpoint schema, authenticated by copying a browser session cookie.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
